act: AIFC Conduct of Business Rules (COB), V17

en.title: Client asset rules give regulatory roles to 'the AIFC' (the Centre) where the regulator, the AFSA, is meant
en.summary: The Glossary defines AIFC as the Astana International Financial Centre (a territory/regime). COB nevertheless says: firms must demonstrate grounds 'to the AIFC's satisfaction' (8.2.11, 8.3.8); Client Money may be paid out in circumstances 'otherwise authorised by the AIFC' (8.2.13(e)); disclosure of 'other Distribution Event stipulated by the AIFC' (8.2.18(a)(ii)). The parallel collateral disclosure (8.3.2(d)) says 'stipulated by the AFSA', and the Glossary Distribution Event (c) is a direction by the AFSA.
en.correction: Please replace "AIFC" with "AFSA" in COB 8.2.11, 8.2.18(a)(ii) and 8.3.8, and state in COB 8.2.13(e) whether "authorised by the AFSA" or "authorised under the AIFC Acts" is meant.
